title: Local model management in Settings and model pickers
description: Local model management in Settings and model pickers for the approved ARA-022 plan.
acceptance_criteria: Given missing weights, when Settings or a picker opens, then unavailable local choices show reasons and guarded accessible activation.
Given active or paused work, when navigating/remounting, then Settings and Activity restore authoritative progress and appropriate controls.
Given verification completion, when availability changes, then selectors refresh without changing the saved default automatically.
Given default-weight deletion, when confirmed, then saved preferences stay visible and unavailable generation is blocked with actionable controls.
test_cases: Local-model Settings, picker and Activity RTL tests for progress/stages/pending controls/retries/default preservation.
Frontend strict TypeScript/ESLint/Vitest and production build.
ARA-048 browser navigation, pause/reload/resume, deletion and native-provider fixture journeys.
verification: Strict TypeScript/ESLint/build and 356 Vitest tests across 54 files passed. Independent review cleared anchor scrolling/focus, focus readiness refresh and persistent terminal live status. Missing-default and settings-outage guards prevent automatic paid selection. Desktop 1440/mobile 390 light+dark inspected without overflow; heading-focus correction confirmed once. Activity reports stopping/verification stages in plain language. All 12 browser scenarios passed, including four local-model journeys; deletion and local generation 2 reran successfully after final backend sampling correction.
